The only outlier is one CompressionFunction cold start (request 1fd8510e) with Init Duration 473.36 ms and Billed Duration 1067 ms, which is Lambda's normal init billing (593 ms execution plus 473 ms init) and not a configuration fault. The log output is truncated (about 4804 events unseen), so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
